app.title: EquiBudget
app.subtitle: Equitable Household Splits • Sinking Funds Accrual • Clean Architecture
app.footer: EquiBudget • Self-Hosted Architecture for Equitable Household Finance & Accrual Accounting

auth.modalSubtitle: Forward-Auth / Reverse-Proxy Headers & Standalone JWT fallback
auth.proxyNoticeBody: Incoming HTTP requests are intercepted by your ingress (Pangolin / Authelia / Traefik). The backend trusts the forwarded identity headers injected by the internal Docker network.
auth.jwtNoticeBody: When operating without a reverse proxy, the backend issues cryptographic JSON Web Tokens (HS256/RS256) upon local login.

cashflow.bannerTitle: Equitable Spending Split & Pocket Money Engine
cashflow.bannerDesc: Eliminate wage disparity tension in couples and households. Our Equal Remaining Amount model ensures that after paying shared household bills and sinking fund provisions, both partners retain the exact same discretionary allowance.
cashflow.sankeyDesc: Visualization of gross-to-net income, central household pooling, and equitable pocket money distribution.
cashflow.subsidizedNotice: Subsidized by partner to equalize discretionary spend.

sinkingFunds.bannerTitle: Virtual Sinking Funds & Periodic Cash Smoothing
sinkingFunds.bannerDesc: Eliminate unexpected quarterly or annual expense spikes. Non-monthly commitments (annual car insurance, quarterly heating, property taxes) are broken down into steady monthly provisions, saving you from budget deficits.
sinkingFunds.smoothlyAbsorbed: Absorbed smoothly into monthly shared expenses
sinkingFunds.billArrivesPrompt: Bill arrives via bank statement debit?
sinkingFunds.createModalSubtitle: Enter periodic expense details. The system computes the exact monthly provision.
sinkingFunds.fundNamePlaceholder: e.g., Annual Ski Trip or Car Maintenance
sinkingFunds.rebalanceModalSubtitle: Transfer accrued balances from one virtual sinking fund to another.

transactions.bannerDesc: Import CSV/CAMT.053 bank exports with customizable column mapping. Unmatched records flow through Stage 1 deterministic regex/IBAN rules, then automatically trigger the Stage 2 AI classification plugin to identify categories and sinking fund debits.

accounts.bannerSubtag: Physical Accounts vs Virtual Sinking Buckets
accounts.bannerDesc: No need to open dozens of bank sub-accounts. Your physical checking and high-yield savings accounts pool the cash, while our virtual ledger tracks exact earmarked allocations for car insurance, heating, and vacation reserves.
accounts.uncommittedReady: Uncommitted cash ready for monthly budgets

blueprint.bannerDesc: Complete architectural specification, domain models, mathematical formulas, and orchestration code for splitting into household-budget-backend and household-budget-frontend repositories.
blueprint.erdSubtitle: Multi-tenant relational database schema with Person-vs-User detachment, global income handling, and virtual sinking funds.
blueprint.backendSubtitle: Layered architecture with isolated domain engines, repository pattern, Alembic migrations, and proxy auth.
blueprint.allocSubtitle: Guarantees that each partner retains the exact same discretionary pocket money after shared bills and provisions.
blueprint.accrualTitle: 2. AccrualCalculator (Monthly Sinking Fund Provisions & Debit Offset)
blueprint.accrualSubtitle: Converts annual/quarterly bills into steady monthly reserves and manages balance offsets when actual bank debits hit.
blueprint.matcherSubtitle: 2-Stage matching pipeline with deterministic regex/IBAN rules followed by modular LLM/AI classification.
blueprint.apiSubtitle: FastAPI controller routes for Authentication, Allocation, Sinking Funds, Ingestion, and Matching.
blueprint.frontendSubtitle: Single Page Application layout with TanStack Query hooks, SVG Sankey flow visualizer, and responsive UI.
blueprint.dockerSubtitle: Multi-container orchestration for PostgreSQL 16, FastAPI backend, SPA frontend, and Forward-Auth proxy integration.

errors.ERR_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: Account with specified ID was not found.
errors.ERR_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Insufficient fund balance for the requested reallocation.
errors.ERR_INVALID_IMPORT_FORMAT: Uploaded statement file format is invalid or missing required column headers.
errors.ERR_BUDGET_OVERDRAWN: Monthly spending limit exceeded for this category.
errors.ERR_UNAUTHORIZED_PROXY: Inbound reverse-proxy identity headers were missing or untrusted.
errors.ERR_NO_ACTIVE_EARNERS: Household must contain at least one registered earner to calculate allocations.
errors.ERR_FUND_REBALANCE_EXCEEDED: Reallocation amount exceeds the current accumulated balance of the source fund.
errors.ERR_MATCHING_RULE_INVALID: Pattern regex syntax in matching rule is malformed.
